headline: SL Green Reports Manhattan Office Occupancy Reaching 95% in Q3
summary: Office REIT SL Green Realty reported third-quarter occupancy across its Manhattan commercial portfolio reached 95%, with leasing mark-to-market rates advancing 13.6%.
why: SL Green is Manhattan's largest office landlord; its leasing momentum serves as a leading indicator for prime US commercial real estate health.

impacts.name: SL Green Realty Corp
impacts.why: High physical occupancy and rising rental lease rates bolster funds from operations.
